authors: Jimeng Sun；Dacheng Tao；Christos Faloutsos
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们如何找到随时间演变的作者-关键词关联模式？或者在数据立方体中，包含产品-分支机构-客户销售信息？矩阵分解，如主成分分析 (PCA) 和变体，是流数据、文本、图形、社交网络等多种环境中挖掘、降维、特征选择、规则识别的宝贵工具。然而，在上面的示例中，它们只有两个顺序，例如作者和关键字。我们建议将此类高阶数据设想为张量，并利用有关该主题的大量文献。然而，这些方法不一定可以扩展，更不用说在半无限流上运行了。因此，我们介绍动态张量分析（DTA）方法，及其...
abstract_en: How do we find patterns in author-keyword associations, evolving over time? Or in Data Cubes, with product-branch-customer sales information? Matrix decompositions, like principal component analysis (PCA) and variants, are invaluable tools for mining, dimensionality reduction, feature selection, rule identification in numerous settings like streaming data, text, graphs, social networks and many more. However, they have only two orders, like author and keyword, in the above example.We propose to envision such higher order data as tensors,and tap the vast literature on the topic. However, these methods do not necessarily scale up, let alone operate on semi-infinite streams. Thus, we introduce the dynamic tensor analysis (DTA) method, and its variants. DTA provides a compact summary for high-order and high-dimensional data, and it also reveals the hidden correlations. Algorithmically, we designed DTA very carefully so that it is (a) scalable, (b) space efficient (it does not need to store the past) and (c) fully automatic with no need for user defined parameters. Moreover, we propose STA, a streaming tensor analysis method, which provides a fast, streaming approximation to DTA.We implemented all our methods, and applied them in two real settings, namely, anomaly detection and multi-way latent semantic indexing. We used two real, large datasets, one on network flow data (100GB over 1 month) and one from DBLP (200MB over 25 years). Our experiments show that our methods are fast, accurate and that they find interesting patterns and outliers on the real datasets.

title_zh: 大型集群智能系统监控
title_en: Intelligent system monitoring on large clusters
authors: Jimeng Sun；John D. Strunk；Evan Hoke；Christos Faloutsos；Gregory R. Ganger
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 现代数据中心有大量必须监控的组件，包括服务器、交换机/路由器和环境控制系统。本文介绍了 InteMon，一种数据中心监控和挖掘原型系统。它使用 SNMP 协议来监控卡内基梅隆大学的新数据中心。它将监控数据存储在 MySQL 数据库中，允许系统管理员使用基于 JSP Web 的前端界面可视化时间序列数据。 InteMon 与其他集群监控系统的不同之处在于它能够实时自动分析监控数据中的相关性，并向管理员发出潜在异常的警报。它使用高效、最先进的流挖掘方法来报告...
abstract_en: Modern data centers have a large number of components that must be monitored, including servers, switches/routers, and environmental control systems. This paper describes InteMon, a prototype monitoring and mining system for data centers. It uses the SNMP protocol to monitor a new data center at Carnegie Mellon. It stores the monitoring data in a MySQL database, allowing visualization of the time-series data using a JSP web-based frontend interface for system administrators. What sets InteMon apart from other cluster monitoring systems is its ability to automatically analyze correlations in the monitoring data in real time and alert administrators of potential anomalies. It uses efficient, state of the art stream mining methods to report broken correlations among input streams. It also uses these methods to intelligently compress historical data and avoid the need for administrators to configure threshold-based monitoring bands.

title_zh: 多个流中的分布式模式发现
title_en: Distributed Pattern Discovery in Multiple Streams
authors: Spiros Papadimitriou；Christos Faloutsos；Jimeng Sun
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 给定 m 组流，每组中包含 n1,..., nm 个共同演化流，我们希望：(i) 逐步找到单个组内的局部模式，(ii) 有效地获取跨组的全局模式，更重要的是，(iii) 实时有效地做到这一点，同时限制跨组的共享信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种解决这些问题的分布式分层算法。我们的实验案例研究证实，所提出的方法可以高效且有效地执行分层相关性检测。 1
abstract_en: Given m groups of streams which consist of n1,..., nm coevolving streams in each group, we want to: (i) incrementally find local patterns within a single group, (ii) efficiently obtain global patterns across groups, and more importantly, (iii) efficiently do that in real time while limiting shared information across groups. In this paper, we present a distributed, hierarchical algorithm addressing these problems. Our experimental case study confirms that the proposed method can perform hierarchical correlation detection efficiently and effectively. 1

title_zh: 高维多方面流的基于窗口的张量分析
title_en: Window-based Tensor Analysis on High-dimensional and Multi-aspect Streams
authors: Jimeng Sun；Spiros Papadimitriou；Philip S. Yu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 数据流值通常与多个方面相关。例如，来自环境传感器的每个值可以具有关联的类型（例如，温度、湿度等）以及位置。除了时间戳之外，类型和位置是另外两个方面。如何对此类流进行建模？如何同时发现多个方面内部和跨多个方面的模式？如何以流式传输方式增量地做到这一点？在本文中，所有这些问题都通过通用数据模型、张量流和有效的算法框架——基于窗口的张量分析（WTA）来解决。 WTA 的两种变体，独立窗口张量分析 (IW) 和移动窗口张量分析 (MW)，在实际数据上进行了广泛的介绍和评估...
abstract_en: Data stream values are often associated with multiple aspects. For example, each value from environmental sensors may have an associated type (e.g., temperature, humidity, etc) as well as location. Aside from timestamp, type and location are the two additional aspects. How to model such streams? How to simultaneously find patterns within and across the multiple aspects? How to do it incrementally in a streaming fashion? In this paper, all these problems are addressed through a general data model, tensor streams, and an effective algorithmic framework, window-based tensor analysis (WTA). Two variations of WTA, independent- window tensor analysis (IW) and moving-window tensor analysis (MW), are presented and evaluated extensively on real datasets. Finally, we illustrate one important application, multi-aspect correlation analysis (MACA), which uses WTA and we demonstrate its effectiveness on an environmental monitoring application.

title_zh: 时间序列中的局部相关跟踪
title_en: Local Correlation Tracking in Time Series
authors: Jimeng Sun；Spiros Papadimitriou；Philip S. Yu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们解决捕获和跟踪时间演变时间序列之间的局部相关性的问题。我们的方法基于比较每个序列的局部自协方差矩阵（通过它们的谱分解）并概括线性互相关的概念。通过这种方式，可以简洁地捕捉各种当地模式或趋势。我们的方法产生一个一般相似性分数，该分数随着时间的推移而变化，并准确地反映不断变化的关系。最后，它还可以在流式传输设置中增量估计。我们在广泛的真实数据集上展示了它的实用性、稳健性和效率。
abstract_en: We address the problem of capturing and tracking local correlations among time evolving time series. Our approach is based on comparing the local auto-covariance matrices (via their spectral decompositions) of each series and generalizes the notion of linear cross-correlation. In this way, it is possible to concisely capture a wide variety of local patterns or trends. Our method produces a general similarity score, which evolves over time, and accurately reflects the changing relationships. Finally, it can also be estimated incrementally, in a streaming setting. We demonstrate its usefulness, robustness and efficiency on a wide range of real datasets.

abstract_zh: 现代数据中心有大量必须监控的组件，包括服务器、交换机/路由器和环境控制系统。本文介绍了 InteMon，一种数据中心监控和挖掘原型系统。它使用 SNMP 协议来监控卡内基梅隆大学的新数据中心。它将监控数据存储在 MySQL 数据库中，允许系统管理员使用基于 JSP Web 的前端界面可视化时间序列数据。 InteMon 与其他集群监控系统的不同之处在于它能够实时自动分析监控数据中的相关性，并向管理员发出潜在异常的警报。它使用高效、最先进的流挖掘方法来报告...
abstract_en: Modern data centers have a large number of components that must be monitored, including servers, switches/routers, and environmental control systems. This paper describes InteMon, a prototype monitoring and mining system for data centers. It uses the SNMP protocol to monitor a new data center at Carnegie Mellon. It stores the monitoring data in a MySQL database, allowing visualization of the time-series data using a JSP web-based frontend interface for system administrators. What sets InteMon apart from other cluster monitoring systems is its ability to automatically analyze correlations in the monitoring data in real time and alert administrators of potential anomalies. It uses efficient, state of the art stream mining methods to report broken correlations among input streams. It also uses these methods to intelligently compress historical data and avoid the need for administrators to configure threshold-based monitoring bands.

abstract_en: InteMon is a prototype monitoring and mining system for large clusters. Currently, it monitors over 100 hosts of a prototype data center at CMU. It uses the SNMP protocol and it stores the monitoring data in an mySQL database. Then, it allows for visualization of the time-series data using a JSP web-based frontend interface for users. What sets it apart from other cluster monitoring systems is its ability to automatically analyze the monitoring data in real time and alert the users for potential anomalies. It uses state of the art stream mining methods, it has a sophisticated definition of anomalies (broken correlations among input streams), and it can also pinpoint the reason of the anomaly. InteMon has a user-friendly GUI, it allows the users to perform interactive mining tasks, and it is fully operational. 1.

title_zh: 传感器网络中的在线潜变量检测
title_en: Online Latent Variable Detection in Sensor Networks
authors: Jimeng Sun；Spiros Papadimitriou；Christos Faloutsos
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 传感器网络的广泛应用引起了越来越多的兴趣。给定传感器网络，一个关键问题是如何高效且有效地利用它。特别是，我们如何检测许多共同进化的传感器测量之间的潜在相关性（潜在变量）？我们可以逐步进行吗？我们提出了一个系统，它可以（1）从真实的无线传感器收集测量结果； (2)实时处理； (3) 动态确定传感器流之间的相关性（潜在变量）。
abstract_en: Sensor networks attract increasing interest, for a broad range of applications. Given a sensor network, one key issue becomes how to utilize it efficiently and effectively. In particular, how can we detect the underlying correlations (latent variables) among many co-evolving sensor measurements? Can we do it incrementally? We present a system that can (1) collect the measurements from the real wireless sensors; (2) process them in real-time; and (3) determine the correlations (latent variables) among the sensor streams on the fly.

title_zh: 二分图中的邻域形成和异常检测
title_en: Neighborhood Formation and Anomaly Detection in Bipartite Graphs
authors: Jimeng Sun；Deepayan Chakrabarti；Christos Faloutsos；Huiming Qu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 许多实际应用都可以使用二部图进行建模，例如 P2P 系统中的用户与文件、金融交易系统中的交易者与股票、科学出版网络中的会议与作者等等。我们介绍二分图上的两种操作：1）识别相似节点（邻域形成），2）查找异常节点（异常检测）。我们提出了使用带有重新启动的随机游走和图分区来计算每个节点的邻域的算法；我们还提出了使用邻域信息来识别异常节点的算法。我们根据数据集的语义评估邻域的质量，并且我们还通过手动测量异常检测算法的性能......
abstract_en: Many real applications can be modeled using bipartite graphs, such as users vs. files in a P2P system, traders vs. stocks in a financial trading system, conferences vs. authors in a scientific publication network, and so on. We introduce two operations on bipartite graphs: 1) identifying similar nodes (Neighborhood formation), and 2) finding abnormal nodes (Anomaly detection). And we propose algorithms to compute the neighborhood for each node using random walk with restarts and graph partitioning; we also propose algorithms to identify abnormal nodes, using neighborhood information. We evaluate the quality of neighborhoods based on semantics of the datasets, and we also measure the performance of the anomaly detection algorithm with manually injected anomalies. Both effectiveness and efficiency of the methods are confirmed by experiments on several real datasets.

title_zh: 二分图中的相关性搜索和异常检测
title_en: Relevance search and anomaly detection in bipartite graphs
authors: Deepayan Chakrabarti；Jimeng Sun；Christos Faloutsos；Huiming Qu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 许多实际应用都可以使用二部图进行建模，例如 P2P 系统中的用户与文件、金融交易系统中的交易者与股票、科学出版网络中的会议与作者等等。我们介绍二分图上的两种操作：1）识别相似节点（相关性搜索），2）查找连接不相关节点的节点（异常检测）。我们提出了使用带有重新启动的随机游走和图分区来计算每个节点的相关性得分的算法；我们还提出了使用相关性分数来识别异常的算法。我们根据数据集的语义评估相关性搜索的质量，并且我们还使用以下方法衡量异常检测算法的性能......
abstract_en: Many real applications can be modeled using bipartite graphs, such as users vs. files in a P2P system, traders vs. stocks in a financial trading system, conferences vs. authors in a scientific publication network, and so on. We introduce two operations on bipartite graphs: 1) identifying similar nodes (relevance search), and 2) finding nodes connecting irrelevant nodes (anomaly detection). And we propose algorithms to compute the relevance score for each node using random walk with restarts and graph partitioning; we also propose algorithms to identify anomalies, using relevance scores. We evaluate the quality of relevance search based on semantics of the datasets, and we also measure the performance of the anomaly detection algorithm with manually injected anomalies. Both effectiveness and efficiency of the methods are confirmed by experiments on several real datasets.

title_zh: 时空追问过去、现在、未来
title_en: Querying about the Past, the Present, and the Future in Spatio-Temporal
authors: Jimeng Sun；Bin Liu；Yufei Tao；Dimitris Papadias
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 移动物体（例如道路网络中的车辆）以数据流的形式不断生成大量时空信息。由于数据的高度动态性以及对快速在线计算的需求，对此类流的有效管理是一个具有挑战性的目标。我们提出了一种在时空数据库中对当前、过去或未来进行近似查询处理的新方法。特别是，我们首先提出了一种用于当前查询的可增量更新的多维直方图。其次，我们开发了一个用于维护和查询历史数据的通用架构。第三，我们实现了一种随机方法来预测涉及未来的查询结果。最后，我们尝试...
abstract_en: Moving objects (e.g., vehicles in road networks) continuously generate large amounts of spatio-temporal information in the form of data streams. Efficient management of such streams is a challenging goal due to the highly dynamic nature of the data and the need for fast, online computations. We present a novel approach for approximate query processing about the present, past, or the future in spatio-temporal databases. In particular, we first propose an incrementally updateable, multidimensional histogram for present-time queries. Second, we develop a general architecture for maintaining and querying historical data. Third, we implement a stochastic approach for predicting the results of queries that refer to the future. Finally, we experimentally prove the effectiveness and efficiency of our techniques using a realistic simulation.

title_zh: 预测时空查询的选择性估计
title_en: Selectivity Estimation for Predictive Spatio-Temporal Queries
authors: Jimeng Sun；Dimitris Papadias；Yufei Tao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于预测时空窗口查询的选择性估计的成本模型。最初，我们专注于捕获点和矩形的统一数据提议公式，以及任何类型的对象/查询移动性组合（即动态对象、动态查询或两者）。然后，我们通过引入时空直方图将该模型应用于非均匀数据集，时空直方图除了空间之外，还考虑分区过程中的速度分布。我们技术的优点是（i）高精度（比以前的技术误差低1-2个数量级），（ii）处理所有查询类型的能力，以及（iii）高效处理更新。
abstract_en: We propose a cost model for selectivity estimation of predictive spatio-temporal window queries. Initially, we focus on uniform data proposing formulae that capture both points and rectangles, and any type of object/query mobility combination (i.e., dynamic objects, dynamic queries or both). Then, we apply the model to nonuniform datasets by introducing spatio-temporal histograms, which in addition to the spatial, also consider the velocity distributions during partitioning. The advantages of our techniques are (i) high accuracy (1-2 orders of magnitude lower error than previous techniques), (ii) ability to handle all query types, and (iii) efficient handling of updates.

title_zh: 预测时空查询分析
title_en: Analysis of predictive spatio-temporal queries
authors: Dimitris Papadias；Yufei Tao；Jimeng Sun
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 给定一组对象 S ，时空窗口查询 q 检索将在（未来）间隔 q T 期间与窗口相交的 S 对象。最近邻查询 q 检索在 q T 期间最接近 q 的 S 对象。给定阈值 d ，时空连接会从两个数据集中检索对象对，这些对象对在 q T 期间彼此距离 d 以内。在本文中，我们提出了概率成本模型，用于估计时空窗口查询和连接的选择性，以及查询与其最近邻居之间的预期距离。我们的模型捕获任意维度中的任何查询/对象移动性组合（移动查询、移动对象或两者）以及任何数据类型（点和矩形）...
abstract_en: Given a set of objects S , a spatio-temporal window query q retrieves the objects of S that will intersect the window during the (future) interval q T . A nearest neighbor query q retrieves the objects of S closest to q during q T . Given a threshold d , a spatio-temporal join retrieves the pairs of objects from two datasets that will come within distance d from each other during q T . In this article, we present probabilistic cost models that estimate the selectivity of spatio-temporal window queries and joins, and the expected distance between a query and its nearest neighbor(s). Our models capture any query/object mobility combination (moving queries, moving objects or both) and any data type (points and rectangles) in arbitrary dimensionality. In addition, we develop specialized spatio-temporal histograms, which take into account both location and velocity information, and can be incrementally maintained. Extensive performance evaluation verifies that the proposed techniques produce highly accurate estimation on both uniform and non-uniform data.

title_zh: 关于移动对象的历史聚合信息的索引和检索
title_en: Indexing and Retrieval of Historical Aggregate Information about Moving Objects
authors: Qiongmao Shen；Nikos Mamoulis；Jun Zhang；Dimitris Papadias；Jimeng Sun；Yufei Tao
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 时空数据库存储有关各个对象随时间变化的位置的信息。然而，在许多应用中，例如交通监管或移动通信系统，只需要汇总数据，例如特定时期内某个地区的平均汽车数量，或每天由小区提供服务的电话数量。虽然这些信息可以从操作数据库中获得，但其计算成本很高，导致在线处理不适用。一个重要的解决方案是构建时空数据仓库。在本文中，我们描述了一个支持时空数据上的 OLAP 操作的框架。我们认为空间和时间维度应该建模为数据立方体上的组合维度......
abstract_en: Spatio-temporal databases store information about the positions of individual objects over time. In many applications however, such as traffic supervision or mobile communication systems, only summarized data, like the average number of cars in an area for a specific period, or phones serviced by a cell each day, is required. Although this information can be obtained from operational databases, its computation is expensive, rendering online processing inapplicable. A vital solution is the construction of a spatiotemporal data warehouse. In this paper, we describe a framework for supporting OLAP operations over spatiotemporal data. We argue that the spatial and temporal dimensions should be modeled as a combined dimension on the data cube and present data structures, which integrate spatiotemporal indexing with pre-aggregation. While the well-known materialization techniques require a-priori knowledge of the grouping hierarchy, we develop methods that utilize the proposed structures for efficient execution of ad-hoc group-bys. Our techniques can be used for both static and dynamic dimensions. 1
